chemistry-killer-09.title: Mole
chemistry-killer-09.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-09.material: A amsawar $\mathrm{aA(g) + bB(g) \rightarrow cC(g)}$, inda iskar gas A da B ke amsawa a zafi da matsin lamba tsayayye su samar da iskar gas C, A 20 mL da B 60 mL suna amsawa babu ƙari ko rashi kuma ana samun C 40 mL. Nauyin molecule na A shi ne 28 kuma na B shi ne 2, kuma gauraye na 100 mL na iskar gas A da B (matsakaicin nauyin molecule 12.4) an sa ya amsa gaba ɗaya a zafi da matsin lamba iri ɗaya. Sau nawa ne yawan gaurayen iskar gas bayan amsawa ya zama idan aka kwatanta da kafin amsawa?
chemistry-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: A amsawar $\mathrm{aA(g) + bB(g) \rightarrow cC(g)}$, inda iskar gas A da B ke amsawa a zafi da matsin lamba tsayayye su samar da iskar gas C, A 20 mL da B 60 mL suna amsawa babu ƙari ko rashi kuma ana samun C 40 mL. Nauyin molecule na A shi ne 28 kuma na B shi ne 2, kuma gauraye na 100 mL na iskar gas A da B (matsakaicin nauyin molecule 12.4) an sa ya amsa gaba ɗaya a zafi da matsin lamba iri ɗaya. Sau nawa ne yawan gaurayen iskar gas bayan amsawa ya zama idan aka kwatanta da kafin amsawa?
chemistry-killer-09.s.s1.explain:
Mataki na 1: Rabon girma A:B:C = 20:60:40 = 1:3:2, wato $\mathrm{A + 3B \rightarrow 2C}$.
Mataki na 2: Girman A a cikin 100 mL na gauraye shi ne x: (28x + 2(100 − x))/100 = 12.4 → 26x + 200 = 1240 → x = 40 mL. Don haka A 40 mL, B 60 mL.
Mataki na 3: Idan duk B 60 mL ya amsa, A 20 mL ya ƙare kuma C 40 mL ya samu. Bayan amsawa A 20 mL + C 40 mL = 60 mL.
Mataki na 4: Ana kiyaye taro (tabbatarwa da nauyin molecule: kafin amsawa 40×28 + 60×2 = 1240, bayan amsawa nauyin molecule na C shi ne (28+3×2)/2 = 17, 20×28 + 40×17 = 1240). A zafi da matsin lamba iri ɗaya yawa = taro/girma, don haka bayan/kafin = 100/60 = 5/3.
Amsa: 5/3 (a). (Kuskure: 3/5 juyayyen ƙima ne, 1 ƙima ce da ke la'akari da kiyaye taro kawai tana watsi da canjin girma, 5/4 ƙima ce da aka lissafa da kuskuren zaton A 40 mL ya rage kuma jimilla 80 mL)
chemistry-killer-09.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-09.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
chemistry-killer-09.s.s1.hint.0: A zafi da matsin lamba iri ɗaya, yawan gas yana tafiya daidai da matsakaicin nauyin molecule kuma ana kiyaye taro kafin da bayan amsawa, don haka rabon yawa = juyayyen rabon girma. Nemo girman A da B daga matsakaicin nauyin molecule.
